chunks: And if, when you heard it, you had not said: 'It is not for us to speak of this; God preserve us, it is a great calumny!'

key_terms.سُبْحَانَكَ: God preserve us/Glory be to You

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet's companions fail to say when they heard the slander against Aisha?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for validating the purity (Ismah) of the Prophet's household, as it rebukes the companions for their initial hesitation and acceptance of the slander against Lady Aisha before divine revelation corrected them. It underscores the necessity of immediate restraint in speech when hearing unverified reports, a principle that extends to the broader context of the Ahl al-Bayt's infallibility and the community's trust in their status.
